plugins.name: mixshift-ai
plugins.description: MixShift AI skills for Amazon advertising and retail operations against MixShift's MySQL warehouse (legacy dashamazon schema): Sponsored Ads (SP/SB/SD), DSP, Seller / Vendor Central revenue, orders, inventory, catalog. Warehouse access is read-only; the live Amazon API surface adds SP-API reports, retail lookups, AMC and DSP analytics, and Amazon Ads reads plus audited preview-gated writes. Ships mx-data-explore (querying + CSV export), the mx-amazon-* skills, PPC optimization skills, brand-context management (brand setup + render + edit + enrich + delta-merge), per-skill OCL calibration confirm-on-run, design-system HTML rendering, and onboarding commands.
